stories.headline: No technical fault found in ACT Airlines Boeing 747-400 Hong Kong incident
stories.lead: Investigations into an ACT Airlines Boeing 747-400 cargo aircraft incident in Hong Kong, where it overran the runway, found no technical fault in the flight and engine control systems.

Hong Kong Hava Kazaları Araştırma Kurumu (AAIA), uçuş ve motor kontrol sistemleri üzerinde yapılan incelemelerde kazayla bağlantılı herhangi bir teknik arıza tespit edilemediğini bildirdi. Soruşturmanın odağında, uçağın 4 numaralı motorunun iniş sonrasında neden... ACT Airlines’ın Hong Kong kazasında yeni gelişme: Boeing 747-400’de teknik arıza bulunamadı yazısı ilk önce HavaHaber üzerinde ortaya çıktı.
detailed_analysis: ACT Airlines Boeing 747-400 cargo aircraft overran runway in Hong Kong.
No technical fault found in flight and engine control systems during investigation.
Investigation focused on why engine number 4 did not shut down after landing.
stories.strategic_impact: The absence of technical fault shifts the focus of the investigation towards operational procedures or human factors, which can influence future training protocols and safety guidelines for cargo operations.

market_exposure.details: Involved in a runway overrun incident; no technical fault found in flight/engine control systems, shifting investigation focus.
